longDescription:
LibrePCB is a free electronic design automation (EDA) software for developing printed circuit boards (PCBs).

Key Features:

  • Cross-platform (Unix/Linux, macOS, Windows)
  • All-in-one package (project management, library/schematic/board editors)
  • Intuitive, modern and easy-to-use graphical user interface
  • Very powerful library design with some innovative concepts
  • Human-readable file formats
